text: さいきん　はやってる　こと…？

structure.jp: さいきん　はやってる　こと…？

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. はやってる こと = 'things that are popular'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is going on now; てる is the shortened spoken form. はやってる = 'is in fashion'.
